HOW TO USE THIS FILE
- Copy ONLY the first line (the encoded token string, above the --- separator) and paste it
  into the "Encoded" field at jwt.io.
- This is a teaching token with a placeholder signature. jwt.io shows "Valid JWT" (the format is
  correct) and "Unable to automatically download public key" in the Signature Verification panel.
  That is expected. It does not affect the claims you read in the Payload.
